rundown: Paderborn beat E Braunschweig 4-1. It was level at 0-0 at half-time.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 10, 6:57 AM ET. It had E Braunschweig 21%, the draw 24% and Paderborn 55%, projecting E Braunschweig 0.9 – Paderborn 1.7 (2.6 total, Paderborn by 0.7).

Final: E Braunschweig 1 – Paderborn 4. Right winner: it had Paderborn at 55%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
E Braunschweig came in with a 16% below average attack and a 5% leakier than average defense (no current-season scoring; 3 past seasons on file), worth about 19 and 19 games of evidence. Projected to score 0.9, they scored 1 (+0.1 goals, 6% over); projected to allow 1.7, they allowed 4 (+2.3 goals, 136% over).

Paderborn came in with a 9% above average attack and a 5% stingier than average defense (no current-season scoring; 4 past seasons on file), worth about 19 and 19 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.7, they scored 4 (+2.3 goals, 136% over); projected to allow 0.9, they allowed 1 (+0.1 goals, 6% over).

The bigger miss was Paderborn's scoring (+2.3 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 5 against 2.6 projected (+2.4), about the 92nd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Paderborn by 3 against Paderborn by 0.7 projected, about the 91st percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.665 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +2.3 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 531 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams +0 goals. Team corrections so far: Paderborn attack ×1.036, defense ×0.974 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.3 goals), no bet.
